主要内容: Deere and Company fourth-quarter net sales decreased 7% to $8.04 billion, below analyst consensus of $7.75 billion. Diluted EPS fell 13% to $1.83, underperforming analyst expectations of $1.57. Full-year net income reached $3.16 billion, slightly above internal guidance of $3.1 billion. Management projected 2015 net income of $1.9 billion, with net sales declining 15%. Deere's crop price outlook worsened, with corn and wheat prices forecast to decline further. CEO Samuel Allen noted a significant slowdown in large farm machinery sales but assured investors of continued profitability. Deere's guidance for 2015 shows a decline in agriculture and turf segment sales by 20%, while construction and forestry sales are expected to increase by 5%. ACGO Corporation (AGCO) also lowered its forecasts, indicating potential increased price competition in the industry. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Deere & Company (DE).
